svg.title: DeepSeek-R1: GRPO and Multi-Stage Reasoning Pipeline
svg.desc: Architectural diagram of DeepSeek-R1 showing Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), the four-stage training pipeline, emergent self-correction, and distillation into smaller models.

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: DeepSeek-R1: GRPO Architecture & Multi-Stage Reasoning Pipeline

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Critic-Free Policy Optimization, Emergent Self-Correction ("Aha Moment"), and Distillation Mechanics

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1. Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Critic-Free Baseline Estimation

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Samples group of G outputs {o1, ..., oG} per prompt q

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Normalizes rewards across group: Ai = (ri - mean) / std

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Memory Advantage: Eliminates value network, saving ~50% VRAM

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rule-Based Deterministic Verifiers

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Accuracy Reward: LeetCode/compiler pass + math ground truth

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Format Reward: Strict enforcement of <think> ... </think> tags

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Zero neural reward model needed for objective reasoning tasks

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Prevents Reward Hacking: Deterministic tests resist gaming

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2. The 4-Stage Post-Training Pipeline

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stage 1 & 2: Cold Start SFT & Large-Scale RL

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Stage 1: Curate thousands of long CoT examples to seed readability

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Stage 2: Large-scale RL incentivizes self-verification & exploration

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Evolution: Thinking token length expands naturally with task difficulty

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Stage 3 & 4: Rejection Sampling & Alignment RL

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Stage 3: Generate 800k trajectories via rejection sampling + general SFT

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Stage 4: Secondary RL with preference rewards for safety and helpfulness

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Balances STEM reasoning prowess with general conversational fluency

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Final Checkpoint: DeepSeek-R1 full 671B MoE reasoning model

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 3. Emergent Behaviors: The "Aha Moment"

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Dynamic Test-Time Compute Allocation

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Model allocates hundreds to thousands of latent thinking tokens

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Autonomously recognizes calculation mistakes and backtracks

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Phrases like "Wait, let me rethink this..." emerge without supervision

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Inference Scaling: Compute directly translates into mathematical accuracy

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: R1-Zero vs R1 Comparison

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • R1-Zero: Pure RL directly on base model; exhibits severe language mixing

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • R1: Cold-start SFT prevents mixing while maintaining raw RL power

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • AIME 2024: 79.8% pass@1 (matching OpenAI o1-0912)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Key Takeaway: RL alone induces reasoning; SFT guides human usability

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 4. Distillation into Dense Open Models

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: SFT Distillation vs Pure RL on Small Models

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Small models (1.5B–14B) lack capacity to discover reasoning via pure RL

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Direct SFT on 800k R1 trajectories yields dramatic reasoning jumps

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B outperforms original OpenAI o1-mini

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Efficiency: Runs locally on consumer GPUs (MacBook / single RTX 4090)

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hardware Training Profile

text.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: • Total Compute Investment: ~$294,000 for post-training phases

svg.text: • Cluster: NVIDIA H800 PCIe GPUs utilizing DualPipe MoE parallelism

svg.text: • Serving Framework: vLLM / SGLang with continuous prefix caching
